text:
maria: Ran a targeted sweep: SmoothQuant + activation-aware calibration on mistral-7b-long@128k. Compared AWQ-int8, GPTQ-8, mixed FP8, and base FP16. Short summary first: AWQ(act-aware) gives best cost/latency tradeoff with small QA regressions on extreme long spans; GPTQ showed odd perplexity spikes after 100k tokens. Details below.

samir: awesome, did you use the same calibration set for all methods?

maria: yes — 10k multi-domain longspan excerpts (dialog+docs+wiki) we curated to stress KV cache and activation tails. Calibration used clipped statistical moments per-layer.

jon: paste numbers pls — accuracy delta / perf / mem.

maria: results (relative to FP16 baseline):
- AWQ + act-aware (int8, per-channel act scale): MMLU: -0.6% acc, LongQA F1: -1.2%, PPL: +2.1%, GPU mem: 11.4GB (vs 19.8GB fp16), p50 latency (1k tokens gen): 420ms, p95: 890ms.
- GPTQ-8 (standard calibrate): MMLU: -3.4%, LongQA F1: -4.8%, PPL: +8.7%, GPU mem: 9.9GB, p50: 380ms, p95: 1200ms (instability >100k tokens).
- Mixed FP8 (mantissa-like FP8 with act-scale): MMLU: -0.3%, LongQA F1: -0.6%, PPL: +1.0%, GPU mem: 10.8GB, p50: 400ms, p95: 950ms.
- Static INT8 (no act-aware): MMLU: -5.5%, LongQA F1: -7.2%, PPL: +15%, GPU mem: 9.6GB, p50: 360ms, p95: 1400ms.

kevin: interesting that GPTQ had lower p50 but worse tail and accuracy. Do we have logs for activation outliers?

maria: yes — two notable patterns:
1) activation spikes in attention outputs around long retrieval boundaries (100k +/- 5k) — GPTQ quant bins saturate leading to KV cache drift.
2) per-token activation distribution shifts over long prefixes; SmoothQuant + act-aware scaling kept the residuals small.

samir: can you drop the exact command/config used for AWQ+act-aware so we can reproduce?

maria: sure — minimal snippet we ran in the infra harness: 
```
quantize \ 
  --model checkpoints/mistral-7b-long/ckpt-final \ 
  --method awq \ 
  --act-aware true \ 
  --calib ./calib/longspan_set.json \ 
  --bits 8 \ 
  --per-channel true \ 
  --out artifacts/mistral7b_long_awq_actaware
```
We also ran a SmoothQuant pass first to re-balance weights/activations: 
```
smoothquant --alpha 0.5 --layers layernorm,mlp,attn --out tmp/sq_rebalanced.ckpt
```
Full pipeline: smoothquant -> act-aware calibration -> awq quant -> load test harness.

jon: what does the regression pattern look like in the eval set? Are errors catastrophic or soft drops?

maria: mostly soft drops: answers are still plausible but fewer exact-span matches after 80k tokens (F1 drop). GPTQ had some hallucination cases on long retrieval windows — likely due to KV mismatch. FP8 mixed was very stable — small perf hit vs AWQ but better QA F1.

kevin: any inference-runtime caveats? e.g., kernel support, padding, KV cache layout changes?

maria: yes — implementation notes:
- AWQ requires per-gemm scales applied during matmul; our runtime uses fused qmm kernels (available on latest runtime). If fallback to generic GEMM, p95 jumps.
- KV cache eviction: with 128k contexts we saw significant memory churn if we batch >1. Recommend batch_size=1 or explicit prefix-cache for multi-request batching.
- prefix/kvcache: enable prefix caching and periodic compaction every 10k tokens to avoid soft memory blowups.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy created: redwood-dedicated/mistral7b-awq-actaware/slot-12 -> 10% traffic. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/canaries/2213456789

samir: for production, what's your recommended profile?

maria: Proposed rollout:
1) Dedicated fleets: AWQ + SmoothQuant + act-aware as default for low-cost lanes (p50 latency ~420ms).
2) Mixed FP8 as fallback model variant for sensitive QA flows (enable via smart routing when eval-trace error rate > 0.8%).
3) GPTQ only for offline batch/throughput-heavy workloads where tail QA quality isn't critical.
4) Ops: set kv_eviction_threshold=120000, prefix_compact_interval=10000, batch_size_limit=1 for 128k-class jobs.

jon: do we have a small eval harness to run nightly regression checks on longspan benchmarks?

maria: yes — CI job "longspan-quant-regress" added. It runs a 2k-shot subset (5% of full) and posts metrics. ci-bot already pushed artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/quant-sweeps/2213456789.zip

ci-bot: longspan-quant-regress job finished. Artifacts: metrics.csv, per-layer-activation-histograms/, diff_reports/

kevin: any follow-ups? I'm worried about edge-case tokenizers producing out-of-distribution tokens at long boundaries.

maria: good point — next sweep will include alternative tokenization (byte-level vs hf-bpe) and test on chunked retrievals to simulate streaming RAG. Also plan a 200k context probe (if HW permits) to validate the 128k trends extrapolate.

samir: thanks — can you drop the shortened Runbook notes for SRE? I'd like the bullet points to include kernel fallbacks and canary abort criteria.

maria: added runbook stub in artifacts/runbooks/awq_actaware_longspan.md — main bullets: abort if QoQ(accuracy) drop >2.5% on LongQA or p95 latency increases >1.5x vs baseline.

jon: Nice. Can we TTL the heavy calibration artifacts to save storage?

maria: yes — set artifact_ttl=30d on calib/* unless flagged retain.

kevin: lgtm. Thanks for the writeup, maria.

maria: np — will post full notebook + perf traces tomorrow. :rocket:
